subject: [PATCH v3 4/7] sched/numa: separate VMA placement from scan continuation

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Reviewed the patch and found it to be mostly readable, with only minor suggestions for improvement.

2026-09-22.patch_summary: This patch separates the decision of whether a VMA needs placement from scan continuation, allowing for more accurate placement eligibility checks and resolving issues with PID-inactive VMAs being scanned for promotion.
